title: Bet on the Bystander
summary: Johnny bets how strangers in Arroyo will react to three requests V makes, and V picks one reaction to back.

start.bringUp: Johnny wants a game about how strangers react. Bring up, in your own way and smug, that V should walk into an Arroyo street market and make three small requests of three ordinary people, with Johnny betting on each reaction.

arroyo.name: a street market in Arroyo, Santo Domingo

g1.asks: Bet your pick. What does he do? Don't think, just say.
g1.know: Johnny wants V's pick for what the first stranger does before V asks anything. The real reaction is seen afterwards.
g1.wants: V to commit to a pick.

stages.label: Make three requests in the Arroyo market
stages.know: Johnny bets how each stranger will react before V asks. V asks a food vendor for a free taste for a famous man, a loiterer to move on, and a mechanic to admire the sign. One stranger may react in a way nobody bets on.
stages.wants: V to make the three requests and commit to a bet on the next reaction.

do.who: a mechanic at a repair stall

fair.memory: You made Johnny's bet on how strangers would react, and you backed a pick.

lost.memory: You refused Johnny's bet on how strangers would react.

variations.know: Three people at an Arroyo food market: a food vendor, a loiterer on a bench and a mechanic at a stall.
Three people at a transit stop in Arroyo, a vendor, a loiterer and a mechanic who waits for the bus.
Three drivers at a gas station in Arroyo, asked for a free taste, to move on and to admire a sign.
